description: This Java class provides a custom JSON serializer implementation using Google Gson. It serializes all fields of any Java Object passed to it, with pretty printing turned off. The class is marked as a Spring component and is part of the Fineract infrastructure serialization package.

classes.name: ExcludeNothingWithPrettyPrintingOffJsonSerializerGoogleGson
classes.description: A Spring component class that provides a JSON serializer using Google Gson, serializing all object fields with no pretty printing.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a given object into JSON string using the configured Gson instance. Returns null if the serialization result is 'null'.
